news.title: KU students travel to Algeria for international goodwill visit
news.summary_en: Six University of Kansas School of Music students recently joined city of Lawrence officials for a six-day trip to Algeria, where they took part in an international goodwill visit recognizing the relationship between Lawrence and the North African country.

news.title: Witnessing generosity from low-income donors more likely to elicit giving from observers, research finds
news.summary_en: In a new research article, Yexin Jessica Li, Ned N. Fleming Professor of Consumer Psychology at the University of Kansas School of Business, shows how identical acts of giving inspire different levels of moral elevation and downstream generosity depending on who gives.

news.title: KC-135 tanker to fly over KU Lawrence campus before Saturday football game
news.summary_en: A KC-135 Stratotanker will fly over the University of Kansas Lawrence campus Saturday, Nov. 21, shortly before kickoff of the 11 a.m. football game between KU and Brigham Young University.

news.title: KU Symphony Orchestra selected as featured collegiate orchestra at The Midwest Clinic
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Symphony Orchestra has been selected as a featured collegiate orchestra at The Midwest Clinic International Band and Orchestra Conference, marking the first time that the group has been invited to perform at the internationally recognized event.

news.title: KU Law symposium receives national award for student-organized program
news.summary_en: The 2026 Kansas Journal of Law & Public Policy Symposium at the University of Kansas School of Law has been honored with the American Bar Association Section of Environment, Energy and Resources’ Student Program of the Year Award.

news.title: University Dance Company offers diverse perspectives, physicality at its fall concert
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Dance Company Fall Concert will feature ballet, modern contemporary, Bollywood, and free, improvised dance styles — one weekend only, Nov. 20-22 — in the Crafton-Preyer Theatre at Murphy Hall.

news.title: KU establishes research partnership with Kansas-based AI and cybersecurity company
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas has established a research partnership with SOFTwarfare, a Kansas-based AI operations and cybersecurity technology company, to explore opportunities in cybersecurity, trusted computing and artificial intelligence.

news.title: KU students present plans to promote local news in Media Innovation Challenge
news.summary_en: Three teams of undergraduate students presented ideas Nov. 12 to increase revenue at rural newspapers during the journalism school’s inaugural Media Innovation Challenge. Each pitch was presented in front of a panel of five industry and faculty judges for a “Shark Tank”-style competition, with the audience serving as a collective sixth judge.

news.title: 15 Jayhawks named to 2027 Global Scholars cohort
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas 2027 Global Scholars will pursue internationally focused research with faculty mentors, with opportunities to study and conduct research abroad before presenting their work as seniors.

news.title: Babies rarely see exaggerated facial expressions used in emotion research, study shows
news.summary_en: A new paper in Communications Psychology calls into question the value of exaggerated facial expressions commonly used in research to study babies’ emotional understanding. The study, led by University of Kansas researchers, shows that babies ages 6-17 months rarely encounter these expressions in everyday life — and rarely see full faces at all.

news.title: New protocol finds ways to relieve overcrowding at hospital emergency departments, study finds
news.summary_en: In a new article, Suman Mallik, B. Allen and Dorothy V. Lay Professor at the University of Kansas School of Business, examines the efficiency of the full-capacity protocol (FCP), a set of temporary hospital-wide guidelines designed to alleviate crowding at the emergency department.
